The '''Merchant Quarter''' was a sector in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] where [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] conducted business with the citizens of the city and offworlders.

==History==
[[File:Basiliskkotor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Canderous Ordo]]'s [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] in the Merchant Quarter.]]
During the [[Blockade of Onderon]], the Merchant Quarter was the site of protests and riots. Later, the area was severely damaged during the [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|Second Battle of Onderon]]. The [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] and [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Canderous Ordo]] joined the battle from orbit by landing a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] in the Merchant Quarter.
